assumptions.basis: GPP2 photolytic reference physiology. Crop fractions are exploratory allocations of residual carbon, not adopted harvest permissions. Light fractions are sensitivities, not sky-density or climate predictions. Existing tissue construction yield is applied to generic additional organic tissue; it does not predict sugar, lipid, protein or saleable material conversion. Extra crop upkeep, wet-load lifting gas, collection and processing costs are uncomputed and must fit within the allocation; it is an accounting allowance before those costs.

inhabited_clusters.basis: Illustrative dedicated living-area clusters at inherited reference light. Sum only domatia steady tenant allowance; green reserve capacity is not sold twice. Pay routine domatia upkeep from mature green surplus. New domatia replacement, payload gas, connection/floor design and residential services are unresolved.
